items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But you know on Duke‟s side, I know Tyre Glenn for instance [music sounds], that is his tune. [INTERVIEWEE] That‟s right.

ctx.x: That is really Ben‟s. But it is just as you said, it‟s like working for IBM. If you invent something, and you work for IBM it belongs to them. So in Duke‟s band if you thought up a tune…
But you know on Duke‟s side, I know Tyre Glenn for instance [music sounds], that is his tune.
